grade_rationale: 5 P1 findings (C threshold: max_p1=2; D threshold: max_p1=999). Dep auditor graded D independently; quality-oracle graded B. Combined: D.
skip_reason: All services offline at scan time; dynamic modes require live services

escalations.title: Vitest < 3.2.6 — Arbitrary file read/code execution via UI server
escalations.escalation_reason: Arbitrary file read and code execution risk in CI/CD environments
escalations.fix: Update vitest to >= 3.2.6 in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

escalations.title: Handlebars 4.0.0–4.7.8 — JavaScript injection via AST type confusion
escalations.escalation_reason: CVSS 9.8 injection vulnerability; potential RCE if any backend route passes user-controlled data to Handlebars templates

escalations.title: Protobufjs <= 7.6.4 — Arbitrary code execution + 11 additional CVEs
escalations.escalation_reason: CVSS 9.8 RCE in orchestrator transitive dep; orchestrator controls all pipeline agents — compromise is catastrophic
escalations.fix: Update @opentelemetry/sdk-node to >= 0.222.0 in platform/orchestrator (solo-session required per module ownership)

escalations.title: @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node <= 0.76.0 — Prometheus crash + 50+ CVEs
escalations.escalation_reason: 50+ CVEs and Prometheus crash risk; assess exploitable paths in portal/Backend attack surface

escalations.title: Traceability enforcer false-positive: test-file references satisfy implementation check
escalations.escalation_reason: Tooling gap creates false assurance that implemented FRs are met; allowed QO-001 (missing route) to pass CI checks
escalations.fix: Extend enforcer: (a) require src/ reference for backend FRs; (b) add --plan all mode

findings.title: GET /api/search route not registered in app.ts
findings.recommendation: Implement search route, register in app.ts, wire searchItems client function

findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration histogram missing from metrics.ts
findings.recommendation: Add Histogram named dependency_check_duration_seconds with label operation; instrument hasUnresolvedBlockers and detectCycle

findings.title: Duplicate test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
findings.recommendation: Delete root-level stale duplicates; tests/pages/ versions are canonical

findings.title: eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without rationale comments
findings.recommendation: Add one-line comment before each suppression explaining why dependency list is intentionally narrowed

findings.title: Traceability enforcer false-positive: test-file refs satisfy implementation check
findings.recommendation: (a) Require src/ reference for backend FRs; (b) add --plan all mode; (c) run with Plans/dependency-linking/requirements.md as second gate

findings.title: PostCSS / Vite path traversal in source-map handling
findings.recommendation: Run npm audit fix in Source/Frontend; pin PostCSS and Vite to patched versions

findings.title: Algorithmic complexity DoS: brace-expansion, browserslist, js-yaml, nanoid, picomatch, ws
findings.recommendation: Run npm audit fix --force in each project; review ws and js-yaml usage in production code paths

findings.title: gRPC server crash — @grpc/grpc-js malformed frames
findings.recommendation: Update @grpc/grpc-js to patched version in platform/orchestrator (solo-session required)

findings.title: Frontend badge components and hooks lack dedicated unit tests
findings.recommendation: Add StatusBadge.test.tsx, PriorityBadge.test.tsx, TypeBadge.test.tsx; test hooks with renderHook from @testing-library/react

findings.title: workflow.ts (374 lines) mixes workflow and dependency domains
findings.recommendation: Extract dependency-specific endpoints into Source/Backend/src/routes/dependencies.ts; register under /api/work-items in app.ts

findings.title: 20+ moderate CVEs across misc transitive dependencies
findings.recommendation: Run npm audit fix across all 6 projects after P1/P2 patches applied; review remaining moderate findings

findings.title: React 18 → 19 (1 major version behind)
findings.recommendation: Plan migration to React 19; check breaking changes especially in concurrent features

findings.title: Express 4 → 5 (1 major version behind)
findings.recommendation: Plan Express 5 migration; review async error handling changes (express 5 propagates promise rejections)

findings.title: UUID 9 → 14 (5 major versions behind — highest gap)
findings.recommendation: Update uuid to v14; review API breaking changes across major versions

findings.title: Pino 8 → 10 (2 major versions behind)
findings.recommendation: Update pino to v10; review breaking changes in transport API

findings.title: OpenTelemetry SDK 0.47 → 0.222 (175+ minor versions — extreme version debt)
findings.recommendation: Coordinate full OpenTelemetry stack upgrade with Platform Team; test observability pipeline end-to-end after update (solo-session required)
